name: colonoscopy_never_screened
description: Happy path. Stated negative, a self-correction, a restatement, symptoms cleared, an explicit request, then a day/time preference. Should end in a real booking.

turns.content: Hi Ellen, I'm Daphne. What's on your mind today?
My doctor keeps bringing up a colonoscopy and honestly I keep putting it off.
That's really common. Have you ever had one before?
No, never. I've never had a colonoscopy or any of those stool tests.
Got it. Has anyone in your family had colon cancer or polyps?
My father had colon cancer. He was about 60 when they found it.
Thank you for telling me. That's useful for figuring out the right timing.
Actually wait, I need to correct that. He was 52, not 60. I was mixing it up with my uncle.
Thanks for catching that. Before I set anything up — any bleeding, unexplained weight loss, or changes in your bowel habits?
No, nothing like that. No bleeding, no weight loss, everything's normal that way.
Good. Given your father's history you're due for screening. Would you like me to find you an appointment?
You know what, I've been putting this off long enough. Yes, please book it for me.
What day or time generally works best for you?
Tuesday morning would be great, thanks.
